question: Does their model suffer exhibit performance drops when incorporating word importance?
title: Towards Understanding Neural Machine Translation with Word Importance
answer_rationale: The document states that the gradient-based method (Attribution) consistently outperforms other methods, including black-box methods and the Random baseline, across various perturbations, architectures, and language pairs. It is explicitly mentioned that the Attribution method (which incorporates word importance) does not suffer performance drops but rather shows superior results.
